Furnitune – Filtered Business Information

About Furnitune
Furnitune is an e-commerce platform for Santos Upholstery. We offer made to order furniture, custom furniture orders, furniture repairs, and an AI-powered recommender that analyzes room photos to suggest items from our catalog.

Purpose & Objectives
Our purpose is to simplify shopping, customization, and maintenance of furniture online while reducing miscommunication via guided options and reference images.

Objectives:
1) Sell made to order furniture online.
2) Support custom orders (dimensions, materials, colors, design references).
3) Accept repair requests (with photos) even for items not purchased from us.
4) Provide AI-powered recommendations using CLIP + FAISS.
5) Answer customer questions via a business chatbot.

Scope and Limitations
Scope:
- Catalog of made to order items with product pages.
- Customization flow with guided options and image uploads.
- Repair request submission and admin review.
- AI recommender based on room photos and preferences.
- Business chatbot for product/services/policies.

Limitations:
- Furniture only (no rugs, curtains, home decor).
- AI recommender limited to three runs per user per 24 hours.
- Delivery status depends on admin updates.

Key Features
Product Customization
Choose dimensions, materials, colors, and designs. Upload reference images (e.g., Pinterest/Google) to clarify expectations.

AI Recommender System
Upload a room photo and answer a few questions. CLIP generates embeddings and FAISS retrieves visually similar items from the catalog.

Repair Service
We accept repair requests even if the item was not purchased from us. Customers upload photos and details; admins review and schedule work.

Ordering & Payment
Orders are placed online and payments are processed via GCASH QR Code.

Delivery & Tracking
Customers can track deliveries. Status updates are maintained by admins.

Policies & Customer Information
Returns & Refunds
Return requests are handled case-by-case. Provide order details and photos. Approved refunds/returns follow our posted policy and timelines.

Data Privacy
Personal data is used only to fulfill orders, provide services, and improve your experience. We do not sell personal data to third parties.

Operating Hours & Coverage
Business Hours: Mon–Sat, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM.
Service Coverage: Primary service area is the local region; contact us for special arrangements.

Contact Us

Live Chat: Available via the website chatbot
Location: Santos Upholstery main shop at Cristobal St. San Jose Concepcion, Tarlac
